meta.title: Which Halloween Monster Are You?
meta.subtitle: 8 questions to find the little monster living inside you
meta.intro: No star signs, no blood types. Just how you'd really act on Halloween night. Screenshot your card and see which monster your friends get.

questions.text: At a Halloween party, you're usually…

options.text: In a corner, quietly watching everyone
Hyping the room and starting games
Drink in hand, chatting with everyone in turn
Hiding somewhere nobody can find me

questions.text: The candy bowl comes your way. You take…

options.text: The one with the prettiest wrapper
Whatever there's the most of, to stockpile

questions.text: A strange noise at midnight. Your first move?

options.text: Post about it: did anyone else hear that?
Pretend I didn't hear it and sleep
Full glam, it has to look good in photos

questions.text: If you could have one superpower, you'd pick…
What face do you carve on your jack-o'-lantern?
A friend wants to vent late at night. You…

options.text: Reply instantly and talk till sunrise
Send a string of 60-second voice notes

questions.text: After Halloween, what do you miss most?

results.name: Bratty Bat
results.tagline: “None of my business,” you say, already running to help.
results.desc: I've got a bit of a temper, but mess with my people and you deal with me first. I'm useless by day and fully charged after midnight. Don't be too nice to me. I remember everything, good and bad.
results.power: Loyal to a fault, my people are off-limits
results.weakness: Holds grudges into the next life
results.shareLine: I got Bratty Bat: bad temper, fiercely loyal.

results.name: Venomous Vampire
results.tagline: You think you're networking. I'm the one choosing.
results.desc: I know what to say and what to wear, and I always find the best seat in the room. I'm nice to you because I want to be, and I ignore you for the same reason. Polish is my armor, and self-interest is my honesty.
results.power: Makes the whole room remember your name in three minutes
results.weakness: Can't stand anyone looking better in photos
results.shareLine: I got Venomous Vampire: elegant, but only for myself.

results.name: Melancholy Mummy
results.tagline: Wrapped up tight. Only close friends get to see the real me.
results.desc: People think I'm cold when we first meet. I'm just slow to warm up. I wrap my feelings in layer after layer, and whoever is patient enough to unwrap them finds nothing but sincerity.
results.power: Once I choose you, it's for years and years
results.weakness: So many layers, unwrapping one takes forever
results.shareLine: I got Melancholy Mummy: slow to open up, deeply loyal.

results.name: Zoned-Out Zombie
results.desc: I don't compete, and I barely remember what happened yesterday. While everyone else is stressing, I'm thinking about dinner. My happiness is simple: food, sleep, and nobody calling my name.
results.power: Sleeps off any problem, however big
results.weakness: Replies to messages in days, not minutes
results.shareLine: I got Zoned-Out Zombie: brain offline, happiness online.

results.name: Raging Reaper
results.tagline: Give me the job and it's done in three minutes. Make me mad and you're done in three seconds.
results.desc: I keep my word and never drag my feet. My patience is just a little short, and slowpokes make my scythe itch. My temper flares fast and fades fast, and after I blow up I'll still finish the job for you.
results.power: Gets things done, the nemesis of deadlines
results.weakness: Quick to explode, quick to regret it
results.shareLine: I got Raging Reaper: reliable, but don't push it.

results.name: Pessimistic Pumpkin
results.tagline: The roundest smile in the room, with a little rain cloud inside.
results.desc: I look cheerful and easy to be around, and everyone wants me at the party. But my brain is always rehearsing the worst-case ending. My gloom is steady and sincere. Don't worry, though. I still light the candle afterwards.
results.power: Always has a worst-case plan ready
results.weakness: Suspicious of good news on arrival
results.shareLine: I got Pessimistic Pumpkin: cheerful outside, raining inside.

results.name: Jovial Joker
results.tagline: Wherever I am, the room never goes quiet.
results.desc: I was born to hype the room, and I head straight for wherever it's quiet. My joy is contagious and I'll catch your awkward moments. It's just that after the party, I sometimes want someone to sit quietly with me too.
results.power: Makes strangers laugh in three sentences
results.weakness: Can't stop; five quiet minutes feel like torture
results.shareLine: I got Jovial Joker: wherever it's awkward, I'm on my way.

results.name: Conceited Cat
results.tagline: I'm not antisocial. The group just isn't good enough for me.
results.desc: I'm elegant, independent and have taste, and most humans are a bit loud for me. But if you happen to catch my eye, I'll quietly nudge your hand right when you need it most.
results.power: One look makes people doubt themselves
results.weakness: Too proud to ask for the attention I want
results.shareLine: I got Conceited Cat: aloof, with the occasional act of kindness.
